summary:
I wrote the final redesign spec to /Users/oura/Documents/vscode/prime-daifugo/docs/design/redesign-spec.md. It is the only file I changed.

**Base and what it takes from the other concepts.** The spec is built on ふるい (Furui), the Sieve Table, which all three judges picked. It adds these ideas:
- **From Q.E.D.:**
  - **Field and tray helpers:** a "k = 2 枚 · > N" requirement under the field, and tray checks that never hint at primality (枚数 ✓ and > 場 ✓).
  - **Game end:** "Theorem / Proof / ∎" wording on the GAME SET dialog.
  - **Cards:** small value labels under hand cards (A=1 … K=13), which can be turned off.
  - **Seats:** an ∅ mark on seats that passed, cleared when the field flows.
  - **Motion:** a damped-sine shake for blocked submits.
  - **Testability:** a `data-motion` attribute so reduced-motion tests can check the DOM.
  - **Accessibility:** a screen-reader live region.
  - **Process:** tests that pin current behaviour are written before the refactor.
  - **Factorization:** reuse the existing primes-and-factors dependency.
- **From Sectio Aurea:**
  - **Off-turn cards:** desaturated with opacity kept at 1, so faces stay readable.
  - **Action sizes:** a 55px primary 出す button on phones, in a right-hand action rail.
  - **New cards:** an underline for about 2.6 s on drawn or penalty cards.
  - **Ceremonies:** the 57 cut and game end can be skipped with a tap or Esc.
  - **Tray wipe:** a one-line helper toast when a server event clears the tray.
  - **Seat colours:** golden-angle hues. I checked them for contrast and offset them away from the prime and gold colours.
  - **Flow motion:** field cards sweep into the deck along a logarithmic spiral.
  - **Event handling:** `classifyTransition` as a pure function, and springs defined by `visualDuration` and `bounce`.

**What the spec contains:**
- **Hard constraints.** No changes to `src/partykit`, `play-card.ts`, `interface`, `hooks.ts` or `ClientMessenger`. No primality hints before the server answers. No joker or 1729 visuals.
- **Tokens.** Exact CSS variables for light and dark, a `globals.css` skeleton and a Mantine `createTheme` with five 10-shade palettes. I computed every contrast ratio, and all text tokens reach at least 4.5:1. I had to change the dark `--border-strong` to `#6E7483`, because the concept's value failed on the raised surface.
- **Typography and spacing.** Geist and Geist Mono loaded with `next/font/local` (no new downloads), a 1.25 type scale, spacing in Fibonacci × 4px steps, and one layout-mode hook (compact / portrait / regular / wide) replacing the four breakpoint systems.
- **Components.** A full inventory with props for each new or changed component.
- **Wireframes.** Home, login, `/room/new`, waiting room, the game board for phone landscape (pixel budget 384 of 390), desktop and portrait, overlays, and `/labo/calc`.
- **Cards.** The 52 existing face SVGs stay, restyled through a `MathCard` wrapper. The card back becomes an Ulam spiral.
- **Animation.** A 31-row event catalogue with framer-motion variants, Fibonacci-millisecond durations and a reduced-motion fallback for each row. A board director reorders the server's out-of-order game-end messages.
- **Tests.** Required assertions for every module, Storybook play tests, and a Playwright screenshot script that runs against a `/labo/gallery` page with mock state, so no PartyKit server is needed.

**Decisions you should check:**
- On phones, the QR popover no longer opens by default.
- daisyUI is removed.
- One new per-viewer localStorage key, `showCardValues`, stores the value-label setting.
- `npm test` will run only the unit tests. Storybook tests move to a separate `npm run test:storybook`.
- I did not add `force-dynamic` to `/room/new`; it is left as a flagged option.

**Plan.** The foundation task runs first. After it, five tasks (T1 cards, T2 table, T3 board, T4 screens, T5 labo) can run in parallel with no shared files. The foundation creates the board barrel, the prop types and placeholder component files. Each later task then takes over its own placeholders, so the parallel work compiles before the other tasks land.

foundation.title: Foundation: tooling, tokens, theme, fonts, shared math and design primitives, characterization tests, board contracts and stubs
foundation.instructions:
Follow /Users/oura/Documents/vscode/prime-daifugo/docs/design/redesign-spec.md sections 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.1, 9.1, 10.1 and 10.2.

**1. Tooling.**
- In vitest.config.ts, add `esbuild.jsx = 'automatic'`, a top-level `@` alias and `optimizeDeps.include`.
- Set up `test.projects`:
  - `unit`: jsdom, include `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}`.
  - `storybook`: browser playwright chromium. Enable it only when `STORYBOOK_TESTS=1`, and use `executablePath` from `PW_CHROMIUM_PATH` if it is set.
- Coverage: v8, include `src/**`, exclude icons, partykit, stories and gallery, with the thresholds in §10.1.
- vitest.setup.ts: jest-dom/vitest, RTL cleanup, polyfills for matchMedia (configurable), ResizeObserver, scrollIntoView, getComputedStyle and IntersectionObserver, and `MotionGlobalConfig.skipAnimations = true`.
- package.json scripts: `test` (unit project), `test:storybook`, `test:coverage`, `screens`.
- Run `npm uninstall daisyui`. Add `docs/design/screens/` to .gitignore.

**2. Characterization tests, written before anything else and run against the CURRENT code.**
- `hooks.test.ts`: `useMessageHandler` dispatch, including no `onGameEvent` on sync or change-rule; `useMyField` cap, sorting, reset and `toggleMode`.
- `client-messenger.test.ts`: payload snapshots for every method.
- `game-board.test.tsx`: use the mocked partysocket fake with `__emit` and a `send` spy, plus a mocked js-cookie. Cover:
  - the hand renders after presence, room-status and game-start;
  - `left-time 0` sends pass only from the current player;
  - an observer gets no hand;
  - the GAME SET dialog appears.

  Query by roles and text using regexes that accept both the old English labels and the new Japanese ones.

**3. Tokens, theme and fonts.**
- Write globals.css exactly as in §2.2: layer order, custom variants, tokens for light and dark, `data-card-size` scale, `@theme inline`. Remove the gradient, the dead utilities and daisyUI.
- `src/design/tokens.ts` mirrors the hex values. `tokens.test.ts` checks the WCAG ratios and parses globals.css to make sure it matches tokens.ts.
- `theme.ts` as in §2.3. `fonts.ts` loads Geist with `next/font/local`.
- layout.tsx:
  - `lang="ja"` and the font variable classes.
  - Layered Mantine CSS imports.
  - `ColorSchemeScript` and `MantineProvider` with the theme and `defaultColorScheme="auto"`.
  - Wrap the body in `MotionProvider`.
  - Move `Analytics` into the body.
  - Remove the empty tabler import.
  - Keep `Notifications position="top-right"`, NavBurger and DeviceRotateRecommender.
- Rebuild device-rotate-recommender in Mantine. Keep the same default export, the sessionStorage key `shouldShowRotateRecommender` and `use-should-rotate`, and use Japanese copy.
- Ulam app icon and manifest colours as in §5.
- Storybook preview: theme, MotionProvider, a light/dark global and the viewports compact 844x390, portrait 390x844 and wide 1440x900.

**4. Shared primitives and math.** Implement these with the APIs in §6.1, plus their tests from §10.3:
- motion.ts: DUR, EASE, SPRING, stagger, dampedShake, motionPreset, variants;
- use-layout-mode;
- NumberGlyph, Expr, icons, SieveGrid, UlamField, ModRing, FactorTree;
- math/sieve, ulam, factorize (primes-and-factors at or below MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, budgeted BigInt above), geometry.

Every animated primitive sets `data-motion`. Add a primitives story file.

**5. Board contracts.**
- `board/types.ts`: SeatModel, BoardEvent, SubmitResultView, LogEntry, LayoutMode.
- `board/index.ts`: a barrel exporting every board component.
- A placeholder file for each board component in §6.2 to §6.4. Each has its exact final props interface (exported) and renders minimal semantic markup with `data-stub`. Ownership of these stubs then passes to T1, T2 and T3.
- Do NOT modify game-board.tsx, page.tsx or any screen.

**Never touch:** src/partykit/**, src/utils/play-card.ts, src/interface/**, client-messenger.ts, room-manager.ts, hooks.ts, middleware.ts, src/app/room/new/page.tsx.

**Acceptance:**
- `npm test` is green: the existing 27 tests plus all new ones.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean. `npx biome ci` passes on the new files. `npm run build-storybook` passes.
- `next dev` shows the token look (paper background, Geist) with no gradient. Dark mode follows the OS. The rotate banner works without daisyUI.
- The characterization tests pass against the unchanged game-board.tsx.

tasks.title: Cards: MathCard wrapper, Ulam card back, accessible GameCard, PlayingCardLine fix, Hand, SubmitTray, FactorPanel
tasks.instructions:
Spec sections: 6.2, 7.5 (hand, tray, factor mode), 8, and catalogue rows 9.2 #11 and #13–#18.

**GameCard.** Keep the contract `{card: CardId|'Back'} & SVGProps`, sizing by `fontSize` and the default `role="option"`. Add a default `aria-label` from `cardLabel()` (the caller can override it) and `data-card`.

**Back.tsx.** Replace it with the 21x21 Ulam-spiral back from §8.2. Keep the same export name and viewBox (201.58x282.22), and memoise the generation with `ulamCells` from `@/design/math/ulam`.

**MathCard** (`m.div` around GameCard). Implement the §8.1 states through `data-state`:
- rest, hover (only for `pointer: fine`), focus-visible, selected, disabled (saturate .618 with opacity 1 and `aria-disabled`), confirmed, error, fresh;
- an optional value chip;
- `layoutId={`card-${id}`}`.

**PlayingCardLine.** Keep the same props, fix the prop leak, render MathCard, and take the column count from `useLayoutMode`.

**Hand.**
- A listbox with roving tabindex: arrow keys, Home/End, and Enter/Space call `onSelect`.
- `fanLayout` from `@/design/math/geometry`, switching to a scroll-snap row when the exposed slice of a card drops below max(32px, 0.38w).
- On my turn, a `--mod` top rule and a 4px lift. Off turn, desaturate only.
- `freshIds` cards get `data-state="fresh"` for 2584 ms.

**SubmitTray.**
- Shows the value as a NumberGlyph, the ≟ glyph, and `trayChecks` (枚数 ✓/✗, > 場 ✓/✗).
- At value 57: a gold border, a `G` superscript and `data-grothendieck`.
- A `shakeKey` change triggers the dampedShake variant.
- Shows `errorMessage` inline with `aria-live="polite"`.
- It is a listbox labelled 提出.
- It must show NO prime or composite wording.

**FactorPanel.**
- Typesets with Expr.
- Shows `= value` and an `=`/`≠` target only when `isValidFactCardIds` is true, using `evalFactCardIds` (read-only import from `@/utils/play-card`).
- Operator buttons `·` and `xʸ`, plus 戻る, all at least 44px.

All motion uses `@/design/motion` tokens, every animated component sets `data-motion`, and the reduced-motion fallbacks follow §9.2.

**Do not edit** files outside this list, especially game-board.tsx, `board/index.ts` and `board/types.ts`. If a prop type needs to change, keep the stub's exported interface compatible.

**Acceptance:**
- Every §10.3 test for these files passes, including:
  - the anti-spoiler test (no `/素数|prime|∈ℙ/` text in the tray);
  - no unknown-prop `console.error` from PlayingCardLine;
  - keyboard selection;
  - fan/scroll switching.
- Stories have play functions. The existing GameCard and PlayingCardLine stories still work.
- `npm test` and `tsc` are green.

tasks.title: Table: seats (line and ring), turn timer, field stack and sequence, deck, result overlay, 57 cut, GAME SET dialog
tasks.instructions:
Spec sections: 6.3, 7.5–7.7, and catalogue rows 9.2 #3, #7–#12 and #19–#26.

**seat-model.ts** (pure). `buildSeats`:
- Order seats by `ctx.playOrder` and rotate so self is first.
- Keep only ids present in `gameState.players`. Flag observers (presence ids not in players).
- Lead = `deckTopPlayer`. Mark passed ids.
- `hueIndex` = the playOrder index, mapped to `--seat-0..3`.
- No seat is active when `currentPlayer` is not in players.

**Seat.**
- Name, hue dot, a mini back (`MathCard` from `@/game-card/src` or GameCard 'Back') and the count.
- Markers: `▲` lead, `∅` passed, `観戦` observer, `aria-current` when active, a `+n` penalty chip.
- NEVER render opponent card faces.

**SeatLine.** The compact residue line `ℤ/nℤ ① → ② … ↺`, with a shared `layoutId="turn-pointer"`.

**SeatRing.** The wide ellipse: a = .42W, b = .34H, `seatAngle` from `@/design/math/geometry`, a spring-rotated turn radius, the `--mod` direction arc, and a faint SieveGrid backdrop that shimmers once on a prime play.

**TurnTimer.**
- An SVG ring using `timerDash`.
- Negative values display as 0.
- `data-urgency`: warn at 10 s or less, danger at 5 s or less with a pulse.
- `role="timer"` with aria-valuenow and aria-valuemax.

**FieldStack and FieldSequence.**
- The top cards and `= NumberGlyph`.
- The constraint readout `k = N 枚 · > V`, or `k = 自由` when the field is empty.
- The sequence `13 < 47 < 1013`, collapsing to `… <` past 3 values.
- A strike-out animation for flow.
- An optional phyllotaxis layout that never shrinks text below `--fs--1`.
- A `variant` slot only.

**DeckPile.** Stacked backs, the count, a `data-anchor="deck"` element, and a disabled-reason tooltip: ドロー済み / 山札なし / 手番ではありません.

**ResultOverlay.** One visual per result code:
- ok: prime underline and shimmer;
- BASE_IS_NOT_PRIME: FactorTree using `factorize` from `@/design/math/factorize`, computed only from the props given after the result;
- FACT_CONTAIN_NOT_PRIME: the offending factor boxed with `∉ℙ`;
- INCORRECT_ANSWER: `=` morphing to `≠`;
- a `+n` penalty chip in every case;
- call `onDone` when the animation finishes.

**GrothendieckCut.** A gold slash, an optional card cleave (a dissolve fallback is acceptable), the caption `57 — グロタンディーク素数切り`, then `もう一度`. Tap or Esc skips and calls `onDone`.

**GameSetDialog.**
- A Mantine Modal, width 610.
- Copy: "Theorem. {winner} の勝ち。 Proof. |H_{winner}| = 0.", a standings mini-table, and the Q.E.D. ∎ stamp using the bounce spring.
- The CTA 次のラウンドを開始 calls `onNextRound`. Tap or Esc skips the animation.

Every component reads `@/design/motion` and sets `data-motion`, with the reduced-motion fallbacks from §9.2.

**Do not edit** files outside this list. Keep the stub's exported prop interfaces compatible.

**Acceptance:** every §10.3 test for these files passes, including:
- no faces for opponents;
- the observer quirk;
- timer clamping and urgency;
- the readouts;
- each result code;
- skippable ceremonies;
- `seat-model` table tests.

Stories in light and dark for N = 2, 3 and 4, including an observer case. `npm test` and `tsc` are green.

tasks.title: Board container and room chrome: thin GameBoard, BoardLayout grids, ActionBar rail, director and classifyTransition, ProofLog, LiveRegion, ConnectionOverlay, RoomHeader, QR, notifications, room page
tasks.instructions:
Spec sections: 6.4, 7.5–7.7, 9.2 (#8–#10, #18, #28–#31), 9.3 and 9.5. **game-board.tsx.** Rewrite it as a thin container, ideally under 250 lines. - Keep the same named export and props `{id, size?, onLogNotification?}`. - Keep unchanged: - the socket via `usePartySocket`, with `sendName` on open; - `useMessageHandler` and `useMyField` (imports unchanged; `hooks.ts` is NOT editable); - every `ClientMessenger` call; - the `validateSubmitCardSet` messages, text unchanged; - the auto-pass at leftTime 0 from the current player only; - the observer guard; - toast notifications. - Compose `BoardLayout` from the barrel `./board` (the T1 and T2 components) using the §6.2 and §6.3 props. - Derive passed ids on the client: add on pass, clear on flow or when that seat plays. - Show the tray-wipe helper toast `場が更新されたので選択を戻しました` when a server event clears a non-empty tray (at most once per 5 s). - Keyboard shortcuts per §9.5, ignored while typing in inputs. - Format rule-change log entries with `rule-diff.ts`, not `JSON.stringify`. **classify-transition.ts.** A pure `classifyTransition(prev, next, msg, selfId)` returning BoardEvents: deal, draw me/other, submit-ok, submit-fail with code and penalty, pass, flow, cut57 (not flow), turn. **use-board-director.ts.** - A FIFO queue of visual events only. State is applied immediately and is never delayed. - Hold game-end and room-status waitingNextRound until the next submit event has played, or 800 ms pass. - With a queue longer than 3, play at 0.5x duration. Longer than 6, drop to the latest state. - Under reduced motion, every duration is 144 ms or less. **BoardLayout.** - Compact grid exactly as §7.5: columns 72px / 1fr / 168px, rows 36 / 132 / 76 / 128. Factor mode switches the rows to 36 / 76 / 132 / 128 with a layout animation. - Plus the portrait, regular (log in a Drawer) and wide (320px log column) grids, chosen with `useLayoutMode`. **ActionBar.** - Orientation `rail`: 引く and パス (44px), 素因数分解 (44px), 出す (55px, prime fill), with 出す at the bottom. - Orientation `row` for desktop and `bottom` for portrait. - Disabled reasons. Kbd hints only for `pointer: fine`. **ProofLog.** Numbered entries, newest first, accepts the ReactNode entries from `onLogNotification`, `aria-live` polite. Variants: sidebar and drawer. **LiveRegion.** A `role="status"` region for あなたの番です, results, penalties, the winner and 残り5秒. **ConnectionOverlay.** States: connecting (ModRing), waiting-sync (次のイベントを待っています…), and closed/error (an Alert with 再接続 and `role="alert"`). Desaturate the board underneath. **page.tsx.** - SSR-safe: read the URL into state in `useEffect`. - `cardSizeOption` (localStorage key unchanged) sets `data-card-size` on the board root. - The RoomHeader collapses into the ⋯ popover during play on compact screens. - QR `defaultOpened` only when the layout mode is not compact. - The log becomes a ProofLog. **layout.tsx.** A full-bleed `min-h-dvh` shell; remove the empty imports. **QRButton and notification-message.** Keep the same props and names; restyle with tokens, NumberGlyph and Expr; fix the nested `

`. **Do not edit** hooks.ts, client-messenger.ts, room-manager.ts, waiting-room.tsx (T4), or any T1/T2 component. **Acceptance:** - The inherited characterization tests stay green, with only label regexes updated. - A new integration test feeds game-end, then room-status waitingNextRound, then the winning submit, and asserts the GameSetDialog opens only after the submit (or after 800 ms under fake timers). - The `classifyTransition` table tests and director tests pass. - Shortcut tests pass. - `page.test` shows `renderToString` does not throw. - `npm test`, `tsc` and `build-storybook` are green. - `git diff` shows no change in the forbidden paths.

tasks.title: Screens: home with sieve hero and counters, login with length meter, /room/new loading and error, waiting room as mod ring and axioms, nav burger
tasks.instructions:
Spec sections: 6.5, 7.1–7.4, and catalogue rows 9.2 #1–#6.

**Home** (src/app/page.tsx).
- A HomeHero made of SieveGrid strip strike-out passes, the title 素数大富豪 (`--fs-6`), the subtitle and an UlamField backdrop. The intro plays once per session (sessionStorage `introPlayed`).

**Do not edit** anything outside this list: layout.tsx, globals.css, room page and board are owned by other tasks. Use the `@/design` primitives only.

tasks.title: Labo: restyled /labo/calc, /labo/gallery design gallery with mock state, Playwright screenshot smoke script
tasks.instructions:
Spec sections: 7.8, 10.5 and 6.6.

**/labo/calc.**
- Golden split: readout 0.618 and keypad 0.382, stacked in portrait.
- Readout `n = …` as a NumberGlyph (`--fs-5`).
- Verdict: `n ∈ ℙ ■ 素数`, or `n = p · q ✗ 合成数` typeset with real `·`.
- An empty selection shows `n = —` with no verdict.
- The MAX_SAFE_INTEGER alert stays.
- Hotkeys unchanged: 1–9, 0 = 10, j/q/k, Esc, Backspace.
- Use PlayingCardLine and GameCard (T1 owns those files; consume their public props only) and Kbd hints for `pointer: fine`.

**labo/layout.tsx.** Token styling and a back link.

**/labo/gallery.**
- A client page. Not linked from home and not guarded by middleware.
- Renders scenes selected by `?scene=` with `&scheme=light|dark` (set via `useMantineColorScheme`): home-parts, waiting, my-turn, opp-turn, factor, not-prime, cut57, flow, game-set, observer, connecting.
- Scenes are built from real presentational components imported only through `@/app/room/[id]/_ui/board` (the barrel) and WaitingRoom, fed by `fixtures.ts`: mock GameState, Ctx, presence and SeatModels. No socket.
- It must compile and render against Foundation's stubs, and fill in as T1–T3 land.

**fixtures.test.ts.** Validate the fixtures against `serverToClientSchema` and the game-state shape. Opponent hands are present in the state, but the views pass only counts.

**scripts/screens.mjs.**
- Uses the installed `playwright`, launched with `executablePath` from `PW_CHROMIUM_PATH` if set.
- Targets `BASE_URL`, default `http://localhost:3123`. If the server is not running, it starts `next dev -p 3123` itself.
- For every scene × {844x390, 390x844, 1440x900} × {light, dark}, use `reducedMotion: 'reduce'` and save a PNG to `docs/design/screens/<scene>-<w>x<h>-<scheme>.png`. Also capture `/`, `/login` and `/labo/calc`.
- Exit non-zero on page console errors, except websocket errors to :1999.
- Document the optional PartyKit two-player flow in the header comment.

**Do not edit** package.json (Foundation already added `npm run screens`) or any component outside this list.

**Acceptance:**
- The calc tests (hotkeys, factor text, empty shown as —) and the fixtures test pass.
- The gallery renders every scene without runtime errors in jsdom: add a smoke render for each scene inside `fixtures.test.ts`, or a gallery test colocated in the same file.
- `npm run screens` produces the full screenshot matrix locally with no console errors.
- `npm test` and `tsc` are green.
